reason: I already have my own bike and ride it everywhere, including to training. Paying even 5 euros a month out of my pocket money for something I don't need makes no sense.
objection: I already have my own bike, so why would I pay for one? And with only 10 bikes in town there probably wouldn't be one near me anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If my bike got stolen or broke, I might pay 1.50 for a single ride now and then until it's fixed.
